# ColorCodex Tools

> Public read-only color tools website: color picker, named colors, conversions, charts.

## Agent-relevant endpoints
- API base: https://www.colorcodetools.com/api/agent
- OpenAPI: https://www.colorcodetools.com/openapi.json
- MCP: https://www.colorcodetools.com/mcp
- Service doc: https://www.colorcodetools.com/ai/
- Skill: https://www.colorcodetools.com/ai/skills/site-lookup/SKILL.md
- Skill index: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Auth status: https://www.colorcodetools.com/auth.md
